sections.heading: Two tenses, two jobs
sections.body:
- **Preterite**: completed events — what happened. Often with a specific time or a number of times: *ayer, el lunes, en 2019, tres veces, de repente* (suddenly).
- **Imperfect**: background and ongoing situations — what was going on, what things were like, habits.

Picture a film: the imperfect is the scenery and what was already happening; the preterite is the action that moves the story forward.

sections.heading: Interrupted actions
sections.body:
The classic combination: something was going on (imperfect) when something happened (preterite).

*Yo leía cuando sonó el teléfono.* (I was reading when the phone rang.)
*Estábamos en la playa cuando empezó a llover.* (We were at the beach when it started to rain.)

You can also use *estar* in the imperfect + gerund for the ongoing action: *Estaba cocinando cuando llegaste.*

sections.heading: Mientras and cuando
sections.body:
- *mientras* (while) introduces the ongoing background, usually in the imperfect: *Mientras yo cocinaba, mi hermano ponía la mesa.* (Two things going on at the same time — both imperfect.)
- *cuando* (when) often introduces the event that interrupts, in the preterite: *…cuando llegó mi madre.*

Compare: *Cuando era niña, vivía en Lima* (background: imperfect) vs. *Cuando llegué a Lima, llovía* (event, then background).

examples: Yo leía cuando sonó el teléfono.
I was reading when the phone rang.
Estábamos en la playa cuando empezó a llover.
We were at the beach when it started to rain.
Estaba cocinando cuando llegaste.
I was cooking when you arrived.
Mientras yo cocinaba, mi hermano ponía la mesa.
While I was cooking, my brother was setting the table.
Dormía cuando oí un ruido.
I was sleeping when I heard a noise.
De repente, se fue la luz.
Suddenly, the power went out.
Caminaba por el parque y de repente vi a Luis.
I was walking in the park and suddenly I saw Luis.
El niño jugaba y se cayó.
The boy was playing and fell down.
Mientras hablábamos, él rompió un vaso.
While we were talking, he broke a glass.
Cuando llegué a Lima, llovía.
When I arrived in Lima, it was raining.
Eran las tres cuando terminó la clase.
It was three o'clock when the class ended.
¿Qué hacías cuando te llamé?
What were you doing when I called you?
Veía una película.
I was watching a movie.
Mientras ella estudiaba, yo escuchaba música.
While she was studying, I was listening to music.
Íbamos al cine cuando vimos el accidente.
We were going to the movies when we saw the accident.
Me desperté porque hacía mucho calor.
I woke up because it was very hot.
Estaba en la oficina cuando recibí la llamada.
I was at the office when I got the call.
Llovía mucho, así que no salimos.
It was raining a lot, so we didn't go out.
Ayer fui al médico tres veces.
Yesterday I went to the doctor three times.
Mi madre se cayó en la calle.
My mother fell in the street.
Cuando era niña, vivía en Lima.
When I was a girl, I lived in Lima.
